comingSoonBody: This part of SocietyIQ is being built.

help.title: Help
help.societyMissing: Your society has not added a contact yet.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.emailInvalid: Check the email address, for example name@example.com
auth.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Type it below.
auth.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
auth.useCode: Sign in with an email code instead
auth.wrongPassword: Email or password is not right. Try again.
auth.codeNotSent: We could not send the code. Check the email and try again.
auth.wrongCode: The code is not right or has expired. Try again.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up yet.
auth.notConfiguredBody: Sign-in is not set up on this computer yet. Please contact SocietyIQ support.
auth.devNote: Local preview: type any email ending in @example.com. No password needed.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.body: SocietyIQ keeps your society's records: your name, flat, phone number and email. Your society decides how they are used.
consent.noAadhaar: We never ask for Aadhaar or PAN.
consent.agree: I agree to the terms of use and the privacy policy
consent.agreeRequired: Please tick the box to agree before you continue
consent.notifications: Send me emails about bills and notices from my society
consent.analytics: Help improve SocietyIQ by sharing how I use it (no personal details)

invite.title: You have an invite
invite.body: Your society has invited you to SocietyIQ. Accept to see your society.
invite.expired: This invite has expired. Ask your society admin for a new one.
invite.otherEmail: This invite was sent to another email address. Sign in with that email.
invite.notFound: This invite link is not valid or was already used.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already part of this society.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.inviteNeedsContact: Add an email or phone number
errors.inviteNeedsFlat: Owners and tenants can be invited after flats are added.
errors.inviteOtherEmail: This invite was sent to another email address.
errors.wingExists: A wing with this name already exists.
errors.flatExists: This flat number already exists in this wing.
errors.datesReversed: The end date is before the start date.
errors.notXlsx: This is not an Excel (.xlsx) file. Download our template and fill it in.
errors.templateColumns: This file does not have the template's columns. Download our template and fill it in.
errors.tooManyRows: This file has too many rows. Split it into smaller files.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.inviteFlatNotAllowed: Committee roles are not linked to a flat.
